record.question: An essential requirement for all types of injectable formulations is that:
options: It should contain sucrose as a base
It should have ember colour to protect from light
It should be sterile and free from pyrogens
It should be isotonic with blood
record.explanation: Answer C: It should be sterile and free from pyrogens. Injectable products must be sterile and controlled for pyrogens/endotoxins; isotonicity is desirable for many formulations but is not an absolute requirement for every injection. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/pyrogen-and-endotoxins-testing-questions-and-answers. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
